title: Luscious Lamb Wrap
description: Tender lamb, crispy vegetables, and fresh herbs wrapped in a warm flatbread.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.notes: look for flavorful lamb shoulder or leg

ingredients.name: crispy
ingredients.notes: use thinly sliced carrots, cucumbers, or bell peppers

ingredients.name: luscious
ingredients.notes: add a sweet and fruity touch

ingredients.name: fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: such as parsley, mint, or cilantro

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the lamb with salt and pepper. Grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Meanwhile, brush the wrap with olive oil and warm it on the grill or in the oven.
Slice the grilled lamb into thin strips.
Assemble the wrap by spreading a layer of lamb, crispy vegetables, and fresh herbs on the wrap.
Drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds.
